source: docs/settlement-operations.md; values from @xochi/spec 0.9.0 conformance/shielded.json recipientBinding "baseline" (network fixture-a); payout inputs from Riddler test/support/vectors/aztec_payment_proof.json

networkIdentity.typeString: NetworkIdentity(uint256 aztecChainId,uint256 protocolVersion,address rollupAddress,uint256 l1ChainId,bytes32 genesisOrNetworkDigest)
networkIdentity.note: The request's `network` object is @xochi/spec's NetworkIdentity, member for member; its hashStruct reproduces the spec's networkIdentityDigest.

sameFingerprint.name: uppercase hex in every hex member

result.note: A finalized success for these terms. Every included/finalized/reverted observation carries partialNoteRandomness (0x + 64 lowercase hex, or null for an attempt journaled before v2); aztec_getSettlement answers the same observation.

partialNote.note: Recompute from the signed recipient, token and amount, the payout account and observation.partialNoteRandomness; require uniqueNoteHash(i) in effects.noteHashes for some i < 64 and siloedValidityNullifier in effects.nullifiers (effects.nullifiers[0] is the nonce's first nullifier). Values are the @aztec-labs 6.0.0 hashes.

transactionExpiry.note: expirationTimestamp is the transaction's Aztec protocol expiry (tx.data.expirationTimestamp), NOT validUntil. The PXE sets it to min(anchor + MAX_TX_LIFETIME, any lower expiry a call set, rounded down to whole hours, then 30 minutes, then seconds past the anchor). The bridge refuses to send past either bound, but a transaction sent before validUntil can be included until expirationTimestamp. A consumer admits validUntil <= expirationTimestamp < validUntil + maxTxLifetime and must not refund before expirationTimestamp has passed.

oxide.note: sendMode "oxide": the Oxide OXDAI sender. Same wire (pxe-bridge.settlement.v2) and request shape; accountMode must be "standard". The fingerprint adds the line sendMode=oxide right after accountMode=...; a spending_limit request adds no line, so its fingerprint is 0.3.0's.

spendingLimitCounterpart.note: The same terms with sendMode spending_limit (no sendMode line): a different fingerprint.

orderFingerprint.note: The order fingerprint the transfer carries in its private meta is the request fingerprint. meta = [sha256ToField(tag), hi128, lo128, 0...], hi128/lo128 the fingerprint's first/last 16 bytes; the length is the OxideToken transfer(meta) length.

payoutProof.note: Recompute a successful payout note from the signed recipient, token and amount and observation.partialNoteRandomness; require uniqueNoteHash(observation.payoutNoteHashIndex) == effects.noteHashes[payoutNoteHashIndex] (effects.nullifiers[0] is the nonce's first nullifier). Values are the @aztec-labs 6.0.0 hashes and Oxide's computeSiloedNoteHash. The raw reverted observation is a consumer-refusal vector: the bridge holds it because prepared bytes do not commit this proof.

refusals.name: payoutNoteHashIndex null on a finalized success
payoutNoteHashIndex missing on an oxide mined observation

bridgeHolds.note: When the bridge cannot find the payout's unique note hash at exactly one position of a mined transaction's effects (effects unavailable, hash absent, or present twice) it answers this instead of a mined observation; the operation stays marked and is never refundable on it.
